props.name: closable
props.description: Whether the Tag can be closed

props.name: closeIcon
props.description: Custom close icon. Setting to `null` or `false` hides the close button
props.descriptionZh: 自定义关闭按钮。设置为 `null` 或 `false` 时隐藏关闭按钮

props.name: classes
props.description: Customize class for each semantic structure inside the component. Supports object or function
props.descriptionZh: 用于自定义组件内部各语义化结构的 class，支持对象或函数

props.name: href
props.description: The address to jump when clicking, when specified the tag will be rendered as `<a>` tag
props.descriptionZh: 点击跳转的地址，指定此属性 tag 组件会渲染成 `<a>` 标签

props.name: styles
props.description: Customize inline style for each semantic structure inside the component. Supports object or function
props.descriptionZh: 用于自定义组件内部各语义化结构的行内 style，支持对象或函数

props.name: target
props.description: Same as target attribute of `<a>`, works when href is specified
props.descriptionZh: 相当于 `<a>` 标签的 target 属性，href 存在时生效

events.name: close
events.description: Callback executed when tag is closed (can be prevented by `e.preventDefault()`)
events.descriptionZh: 关闭时的回调（可通过 `e.preventDefault()` 来阻止默认行为）
